import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "lr": 0.0007, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

WIDTH = 32
BLOCKS = 4
HID = 64

    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)

    def forward(self, x):
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        return F.relu(x + self.conv(x) + g[:, :, None, None])

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(WIDTH) for _ in range(BLOCKS)])
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 2)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 32
BLOCKS = 3
HHID = 32
HID = 64


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):

class Net(nn.Module):

        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(WIDTH) for _ in range(BLOCKS)])
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(cin + WIDTH, HHID, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HHID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.fout:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.value_head.weight, 1.0)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        x = self.stem(obs)
        for b in self.blocks:
            x = b(x)
        z = torch.cat([obs, x], dim=1)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(z, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            h = F.relu(conv(q))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "lr": 0.0005, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

W = 24
HH = 16
HID = 64
KIN = 16


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.inp = nn.Conv2d(KIN, W, 1)
        self.colmix = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.gmix = nn.Linear(2 * W, W)
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.fconv = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(W, HH, (dy, dx)) for dy, dx in self.fps])
        self.fout = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HH, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.fout:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.value_head.weight, 1.0)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        lay = torch.stack([obs[:, 0:Z], obs[:, Z:2 * Z], obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z], obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]], dim=2)
        below = F.pad(lay, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]
        above = F.pad(lay, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]
        gl = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        zc = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / max(Z - 1, 1)).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        s = torch.cat([lay, below, above, gl, zc], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, KIN, Y, X)
        h = F.relu(self.inp(s))
        hv = h.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        col = self.colmix(hv.amax(1))
        gctx = self.gmix(torch.cat([hv.mean((1, 3, 4)), hv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        c = self.conv(h).view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        xv = F.relu(hv + c + col.unsqueeze(1) + gctx[:, None, :, None, None])
        x = xv.reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), conv, out in zip(self.fps, self.fconv, self.fout):
            q = F.pad(x, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
            res.append(out(F.relu(conv(q))))
        sc = torch.cat(res, dim=1).view(B, Z, len(self.fps), Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(sc, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([xv.mean((1, 3, 4)), xv.amax((1, 3, 4))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

The DONE logit is a learned gate s plus the logsumexp of the placement logits, minus 3, so P(DONE) is about sigmoid(s-3), roughly 5% per step at the start instead of about 0.4%. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 32, "lr": 0.0005, "ent_coef": 0.003, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

STEM = 64
WIDTH = 32
BLOCKS = 4
HID = 64
DONE_OFFSET = 3.0


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv = nn.Conv2d(c, c, 3, padding=1)
        self.glob = nn.Linear(2 * c, c)

    def forward(self, x):
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        return F.relu(x + self.conv(x) + g[:, :, None, None])


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, WIDTH, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(WIDTH) for _ in range(BLOCKS)])
        self.foot = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 2)
        self.place = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, spec.n_types, 1)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, HID), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(HID, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.place.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.place.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.value_head.weight, 1.0)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        x = self.stem(obs)
        for b in self.blocks:
            x = b(x)
        h = F.relu(self.foot(F.pad(x, (0, 1, 0, 1))))
        place = self.place(h).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean((2, 3)), x.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        s = self.done_head(g)
        done = s + torch.logsumexp(place, dim=1, keepdim=True) - DONE_OFFSET
        logits = torch.cat([place, done], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.002, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "n_envs": 256, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 64, "lr": 0.002, "ent_coef": 0.005, "gamma": 0.97, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "clip_eps": 0.2}

COLH = 96
COL = 48
CTX = 32
PROJ = 48
HID = 48
GH = 64


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        cin = spec.in_channels
        self.col = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(cin, COLH, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(COLH, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.ctx = nn.Conv2d(COL, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.gl = nn.Linear(2 * COL, CTX)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(COL + CTX, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.orthogonal_(o.weight, 0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * (COL + CTX), GH), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(GH, 1)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.done_head.weight, 0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.done_head.bias)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.value_head.weight, 1.0)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.value_head.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        c = self.col(obs)
        g0 = self.gl(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        k = F.relu(self.ctx(c) + g0[:, :, None, None])
        f = torch.cat([c, k], dim=1)
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trials yet. The starting network scored 0.000 on dev with both seeds, and we have no data on its training success, so we can't yet tell whether the problem is learning or generalisation. Exact-build dev success needs a long chain of correct ordered placements followed by a correct DONE. The default recipe makes this harder: it gets only 131k samples, runs 4 PPO epochs, and uses gamma 0.95, which discounts the +1 build bonus heavily over 6–33-step episodes. Following the program, round 1 separates the two effects. (a) is a recipe-only change on the starting network: 2 epochs give about 1.86× the samples, and it raises gamma and GAE lambda. (b) is a cheaper residual 2D network with height layers as channels, global context added in every block, a footprint-aware per-cell head and small output initialisation, run with the default recipe. (c) combines (a) and (b). Until dev success rises above 0, I'll rank candidates by mean training success.
analyses.2: All three round-1 trials scored 0 on dev and 0 on training success. None of them failed or timed out, and the longest ran 69 s of the 900 s limit. So the problem is learning itself, not generalisation. Changing the recipe alone, the network alone, or both did not help, but every change was modest. Two things were never tried. First, much larger sample counts: ppo_epochs 1 gives about 3.2× the default steps, roughly 426k. Second, lower entropy: 0.01 spread over 257 actions may keep the policy too random to complete exact builds. On the architecture side, the head never sees the raw layer cells under each brick footprint, and that is exactly the information needed to work out where a brick lands and whether it fills only missing cells. This round tests: (1) the residual CNN with many samples and low entropy; (2) the same recipe with a footprint-kernel head that sees the raw observation plus trunk features; (3) whole-episode rollouts with a long horizon.
analyses.3: All 6 trials scored 0 on dev and about 0 on training success. They varied the recipe (1, 2 or 4 PPO epochs; gamma 0.95 to 0.99; whole-episode rollouts; low entropy) and the architecture (residual CNN with global context, raw-observation footprint head). None showed any learning, so the bottleneck is learning itself, not generalisation. I see two likely causes. First, every trial ran only about 800 to 2,000 gradient steps, because minibatches were large and updates few. Even trials with more samples (426k) took fewer optimiser steps. Second, DONE is rarely explored. Its probability is about 1/250 per step at the start, so the agent almost never stops right after an exact build and rarely sees the +1 bonus. This round tests 3 things. (1) Many small minibatches, giving about 4 times more gradient steps. (2) The same recipe with a new layer-sliced network that scores each anchor at each height layer. (3) The same recipe with a DONE gate that is explored from the start.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored 0 on both dev and training success, and none failed. Changing the recipe (1–4 epochs, 131k–426k steps, gamma 0.95–0.99, entropy 0.001–0.01, small or large minibatches) did not move training success off 0. Changing the architecture (residual CNN with global context, footprint-kernel head, layer-sliced scorer, gated DONE) did not either. Since training success is also 0, the problem is learning itself, not generalisation. An exact build needs high accuracy at every step plus a correct DONE. That means dense learning of the local rule "brick lands at the max height under its footprint, so fill only missing cells" is the bottleneck. This is the last round and any score above 0 wins, so I'm using a few long shots. Each one keeps an explicit footprint max/min/avg pooling head, because that is the clearest way to express the landing rule. Two untested things remain: the starting network has never run with 1 epoch, and no run has used a high learning rate with many optimiser steps. One candidate also tries a wide per-column encoder.
